title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Rate Note: Dining Gratuity Rates on Single-Use Card Purchases
content:
**Rate note.** This note covers the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. On a purchase made with a single-use virtual card and disputed as an incorrect amount, the gratuity rate depends on the purchase's merchant category and on how it was made.

| Merchant category of the purchase | How the purchase was made | Gratuity rate |
|---|---|---|
| dining | online | 15 percent |
| dining | contactless | 20 percent |
| any other purchase, including dining made by chip or as a recurring charge, and every non-dining purchase | any | 0 percent |

Both the category and the way the purchase was made are read from the purchase's own record.

**Points of reading**

- Both conditions must hold. A dining purchase made online takes 15 percent, but a grocery purchase made online takes 0 percent.
- A dining purchase made contactless takes 20 percent. The same meal paid by inserting the chip takes 0 percent.
